<STBG 11,0><BGM 0,0,505><CHAR 1,1,1,0,0><CHAR 5,1,8,6,5><TALK 5><NAME 9><CV 2,2>Big trouble, nya!
Monsters seem to be fighting nearby, nya!

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CV 2,16>It seems to be a turf war, nya.
But that energy — they look like
they're after unifying the land, nya!

<CV 2,1>A crescent-marked Felyne calls it
「the coolest, flashiest party ever」, nya!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,1,7><CV 1,39>Such a turf war could hurt
the surrounding environment...
<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><CV 1,9>We must stop it before it gets hotter!

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CV 2,1><ITEM EVENTPOINT9003001,1,1>I'm counting on you, nya!
Slay them and the guild will give
you these <COL C70101FF>≪Koban≫</COL>, nya.

<CV 2,5><CHAR 5,0,8,7,0>Gather Koban and trade them
at the Exchange for good things, nya!

<ITEM 0,1,0><CHAR 5,0,8,5,0><CV 2,7>A red-headbanded Felyne says there was
something that could truly unify the land —
something 「buzzing with poweeer」, nya!
